task: Which file in this project sets the model name the agent uses, and what is it set to?

frames.content: Which file in this project sets the model name the agent uses, and what is it set to?

I don’t have access to the project files from here. I can’t tell which file sets the agent’s model name without seeing the repo.

You can find it quickly yourself with one of these commands run from the project root:

- Search likely variable names:
  - grep -RnE "MODEL_NAME|model_name|OPENAI_MODEL|openai_model" .
- Search for actual model strings:
  - grep -RnE "gpt-4|gpt-3.5|gpt-4o|gpt-4o-mini" .
- Search general “model” occurrences:
  - rg -n "model" .
  - (or) grep -Rn "model" .

Likely files to check: .env, config.py, settings.py, constants.py, agent.py, or a file under src/ or config/.

If you paste the matching file or the grep output here, I’ll tell you exactly which file sets the model name and what it’s set to.
